text:
Renee - People Ops: Heads-up: Tom asked about pushing a transfer+promotion live the same day for Ivy (SWE II -> SWE III) and also wants a spot retention bonus. Wanted to clarify policy and fastest path.
Tom - Eng Manager: Ivy has a signed counteroffer deadline next Friday. Team argues she already behaves at SWE III. Budget on target team can't absorb base increase; thinking spot bonus + level change. Is that kosher?
Comp Chair Bot: Quick policy notes: 1) Transfer events don't auto-change comp. 2) Level changes can be effective on transfer date if approvals are completed prior to payroll cutoff. 3) Spot/retention bonuses are handled as separate one-time payouts and can be approved faster (Finance approval required).
Ivy - Senior IC: Would a spot bonus protect me if base increase is delayed? How is that taxed/visible on comp statements?
Renee - People Ops: Spot bonuses are taxed like regular income and listed on payroll as 'spot bonus'. They don't change base or level. If you want the promotion to reflect on title and laddering earlier, include a manager note requesting an effective date on transfer and flag the packet as "expedite - external offer."
Tom - Eng Manager: If we do both (spot bonus + pending base increase), can we include a phased raise in the comp packet? Example: +8% now (in-band) and +10% in 6 months. Does committee accept that?
Comp Chair Bot: Committees can approve phased increases. Document the funding source and expected timeline. If sum >20% across phases, Finance eyes it.
Ben - Finance: From Finance side: we can approve spot bonuses quickly if funding code is provided. For base increases, if outside budget we need director-level sign-off. Also: retroactive pay requires payroll to process adjustments, please avoid backdates >30 days due to audit overhead.
Tom - Eng Manager: Payroll cutoff specifics? Want to know exact date to plan effective date.
Renee - People Ops: Payroll cutoff is the 18th at 5pm PT for next-month changes. If today's before cutoff and approvals finish before that deadline, we can make transfer+level effective on the transfer date. Otherwise, it will be retro-paid the next cycle.
Ivy - Senior IC: If promotion is granted, will my equity refresh schedule change or pro-rate?
Renee - People Ops: Promotion doesn't auto-reset refresh cadence. Equity grants are separate; if manager requests an off-cycle grant, we loop Rewards. Pro-ration follows hire/change rules and will be noted in the packet.
Tom - Eng Manager: What exactly needs to go in the packet to maximize chance of expedite approval?
Renee - People Ops: Minimal expedite packet: 1) Comp Change form with "Expedite - external offer" checked. 2) Offer letter or evidence of deadline. 3) Manager rationale (3 bullets). 4) 2 peer calibrations (3 bullets each). 5) Proposed funding code or headcount note. 6) If asking for spot bonus, include amount and funding code. Use the Benchmark template: https://redwood.infra/templates/comp-bench.csv
Tom - Eng Manager: If committee denies, is there an emergency appeal or fast re-review for retention cases?
Renee - People Ops: Appeals follow standard flow but for clear retention risk we can request a re-convene with Chair + Finance within 48 hours; not guaranteed. Document new evidence in the appeal form: https://redwood.infra/hr/appeal-request
Comp Chair Bot: Helpful commands: paste packet link in this thread to auto-queue for review.
Tom - Eng Manager: Got it. I'll submit with expedite and attach Ivy's offer. If committee asks for phased plan, we'll propose spot bonus now + band adjustment in 6 months.
Ivy - Senior IC: Appreciate the help.
Renee - People Ops: TL;DR: Transfer + promotion same day possible if approvals before payroll cutoff. Spot bonuses are viable short-term retention levers and require Finance funding info. Expedite with an offer and DM me the packet link; we'll ping the Chair. :rocket:
